items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I was playing tenor and Bird was playing third.

ctx.x: The only thing about Bird that didn't really knock me out, and I don't want to take anything away from him because I think the man was a genius and he was -- had an extraordinary musical mind. But his sound, you see, it wasn't a standard sound. Although it fit what he did. Because he couldn't play the first chair no place. Well, he didn't read that well in the first place.

But he had a marvelous ear because I remember one time when they did a job at the Apollo and we had -- I forget who we had playing first sax. I was playing tenor and Bird was playing third. And they had a -- what do you call it?
